The final report is well-structured, evidence-backed, and technically accurate. The path was somewhat meandering due to tooling issues and compilation errors in the custom reader, but the agent recovered effectively each time. The thoroughness of the causal chain analysis is impressive.
scenarios.scenario: Deep — Full autonomous root cause investigation and fix proposal
